title: 12 Best Pierogi in Wroclaw
description: Discover the 12 best pierogi spots in Wroclaw, Poland. From traditional baked pierogi to modern takes and budget-friendly milk bars, find your perfect Polish dumpling experience.

places.name: Pierogarnia Stary Młyn
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pierogi Pieczone (Baked Pierogi) with 'Ruskie' filling (potato & cottage cheese) or the 'Z Mięsem' (meat).

places.name: Pierogarnia U Dzika
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Classic 'Ruskie' (potato and cheese) or 'Z Kapustą i Grzybami' (cabbage and mushroom) pierogi, served with crispy fried onions or sour cream.

places.name: Bar Mleczny Miś
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their pierogi options, particularly the 'Ruskie' or 'Z Mięsem', alongside a classic compot (fruit drink).

places.name: Chłopskie Jadło
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pierogi with meat filling, often served with cracklings and sour cream, or their sweet pierogi with fruit for dessert.

places.name: Kurna Chata
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mixed pierogi platter to sample various fillings, or their 'Pierogi z Kaczką' (duck pierogi) for something special.

places.name: Konspira
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pierogi Ruskie or with meat, often served with a side of traditional Polish soup like Zurek.

places.name: Mama Manousch
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic Ruskie pierogi, or inquire about any seasonal/special pierogi offerings that might have a unique twist.

places.name: Piec na Szewskiej
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for their special pierogi with unique fillings, such as duck with apples or specific seasonal vegetable combinations.

places.name: Setka Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A plate of Ruskie pierogi, possibly paired with a shot of flavored vodka for the full Setka experience.

places.name: Ambasada Polska
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Pierogi Ruskie' are a safe and delicious bet, or try their seasonal fruit pierogi if available.

places.name: Przedwojenna Bistro & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic Ruskie or meat pierogi, perhaps with a traditional Polish beer.

places.name: Nadodrze Cafe & Resto Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Inquire about their daily or seasonal pierogi specials, which might offer unique flavor combinations.
